_comment: Hand labels for every answer shown to a customer for an answerable test question, assigned by reading each reply against the help center. correct: the key fact is right and nothing in the reply is false. partly: the key fact is right, but the reply also says something false, contradictory, or garbled. wrong: an answer without the right key fact. The key is '<question id> | <first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the reply>', so the same reply shares one label across profiles, and a changed reply shows up as unlabeled. Declines and answers to not-in-docs questions need no label.
